name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Short non-interactive hint on hover or focus with a shared delay provider, built on Reka UI.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TooltipRootEmits, TooltipRootProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { TooltipProvider, TooltipRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { inject } from 'vue'
import { tooltipProviderKey } from './context'

const props = defineProps<TooltipRootProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<TooltipRootEmits>()

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
// Without an ElfTooltipProvider above, the tooltip creates its own so it works standalone.
const hasProvider = inject(tooltipProviderKey, null) !== null
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipRoot
    v-if="hasProvider"
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="tooltip"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </TooltipRoot>
  <TooltipProvider v-else :delay-duration="400">
    <TooltipRoot
      v-slot="slotProps"
      data-slot="tooltip"
      v-bind="forwarded"
    >
      <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
    </TooltipRoot>
  </TooltipProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TooltipContentEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { TooltipContentProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { TooltipContent, TooltipPortal, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TooltipContentProps>(), {
  sideOffset: 6,
})
const emits = defineEmits<TooltipContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipPortal>
    <TooltipContent
      data-slot="tooltip-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(
        'z-50 w-fit max-w-[min(20rem,calc(100vw-1rem))] origin-(--reka-tooltip-content-transform-origin) rounded-md border bg-popover px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-balance text-popover-foreground shadow-md',
        'data-[state=closed]:animate-[elf-fade-out_100ms_ease-in_forwards] data-[state=delayed-open]:animate-[elf-fade-in_120ms_ease-out] data-[state=instant-open]:animate-[elf-fade-in_120ms_ease-out] motion-reduce:animate-none!',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <slot />
    </TooltipContent>
  </TooltipPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TooltipProviderProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { TooltipProvider, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { tooltipProviderKey } from './context'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TooltipProviderProps>(), {
  delayDuration: 400,
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)

provide(tooltipProviderKey, true)
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipProvider v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </TooltipProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TooltipTriggerProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { TooltipTrigger, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<TooltipTriggerProps>()
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipTrigger data-slot="tooltip-trigger" v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </TooltipTrigger>
</template>

import type { TooltipContentProps as RekaTooltipContentProps } from 'reka-ui'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

export { tooltipProviderKey } from './context'
export { default as Tooltip } from './Tooltip.vue'
export { default as TooltipContent } from './TooltipContent.vue'
export { default as TooltipProvider } from './TooltipProvider.vue'
export { default as TooltipTrigger } from './TooltipTrigger.vue'

export interface TooltipContentProps extends RekaTooltipContentProps {
  /** Extra classes, merged with the base classes through `cn()`. */
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}
